name: Tea Development Scheme
benefit:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**

   1. Seedlings are offered for sale at the rate ₹1/- per tea seedling and one-time financial assistance at the rate ₹10,000/- per hectare.
   1. PP chemicals, equipment, brush cutters, tea harvesters, etc. on sale at the rate of 50% subsidy.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**

**Sl. No.****Entitlement****Owantum of Assistance**1Training programme
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant/farmer should be a resident of Meghalaya.
   1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in Agriculture, possessing own or leased land of not exceeding 2 Ha/family.

**Note:** The applicant farmer can avail of the benefits of the scheme on a first come first serve basis.
